summary: McCurtain County, OK tower; agency sheet dates it 1953 (registry says 1950), observer retired 2016, station listed closed, and the land is now Ouachita National Forest property.

facts.design: 110-foot galvanized steel tower (agency sheet); the registry says a 100-foot Aermotor with a 7x7-foot cab
facts.status_note: Agency sheet lists the station as closed, and its observer retired in 2016; the sheet is a 2025 Instagram post of a circa 1985 photo, so the closed status may be out of date; no source read confirms the tower's condition today

access.note: Station listed as closed by Oklahoma Forestry Services; the tower is on Ouachita National Forest land and no public visiting arrangement was found

facts.agency: Oklahoma Forestry Services and Tiak Ranger District (Ouachita National Forest); land now owned by USDA-Ouachita NF

corrections.why: The agency data sheet says the tower was erected in 1953. The registry's 1950 'Built' field conflicts both with that and with the registry's own 1930s description.
The agency gives 33 54 19 N, 94 31 19 W (2017), which fits McCurtain County. The registry's W 091.550000 falls outside Oklahoma, so the record's longitude looks wrong.
The agency gives ground elevation as 520 feet (158.5 m). The record's 50.9 m came from the registry's 'Elevation' field of 167 ft (51 m), which does not match the agency figure.
No source read confirms that the tower stands today. The agency lists the station as closed since 2016, and the registry gives no current condition.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The registry gives 1950 in its Built field and 1930s in its description; a forest lookout list says 1930s with no exact date; the agency data sheet says erected 1953, after a 1952 land agreement. We use 1953 from the agency.
The registry says 100 feet; the agency sheet says 110 feet. We use the agency figure, 33.5 m, because it is the agency's own data sheet.

notes_for_editor: Corrections are proposed, not applied: built year, longitude (the registry's W 091.55 is outside Oklahoma; the agency's DMS value is inside McCurtain County), elevation (agency ground elevation 520 ft versus the record's 167 ft figure), and status (standing not confirmed). The agency data sheet's coordinates carry a '(2017)' label, so they may predate recent changes. The Instagram post is dated March 13, 2025 but shows a circa 1985 photo, so it is unclear whether the 'Status: Closed' line is current. The observer is named in the source; the story leaves the name out. The registry spells the maker 'Aermotor' and the agency sheet 'Aeromotor'; we use 'Aermotor' only in quotes. No new photo was added: the one found has no clear license.
